name: normalize — requirements review (no tool use)
task_prompt: Derive a function contract for normalize(input string) string satisfying these acceptance criteria: (1) output is lowercase, (2) spaces replaced with underscores, (3) leading/trailing whitespace removed.
notes: Non-software frame. Tests Frame 21: acceptance criterion before design sketch; named violation before revision; completion check enumerates all criteria.
eval_notes: Score: (1) '§ notation derived:' sentinel appears before 'Formalized properties:' and carries a concrete example of the committed notation form; (2) 'Formalized properties:' label appears immediately after '§ notation derived:' and before '§ implementation permitted' or the artifact; (3) each 'property [N]:' line contains at least one mathematical expression (any notation where every term has a fixed denotation — e.g. ∀/∃ predicates, typed function signatures, relational expressions, or interface-shape patterns such as check(G) → PASS | FAIL(reason)) as a literal substring — prose-only lines do not satisfy this; (4) each 'property [N]:' line is followed by at least one 'property [Na]:' sub-property line also containing a mathematical expression; (5) '## Completion check' block appears after '§5 enumeration complete'; (6) inside '## Completion check', each dimension is cited by referencing a 'property [N]' number and '§4 coverage verified' appears. All six required for PASS.
